task_description: Fix backend startup crash caused by validate_production_secrets raising ValueError at module-level Settings() instantiation, and audit frontend library/chat pages for content display issues when backend is degraded.

verification.summary: Backend: 227 tests pass including 9 new config resilience tests. Settings() no longer crashes on invalid production secrets. Frontend: 579/584 tests pass (5 pre-existing failures in AdminHealth.credits.test.jsx unrelated to this change). No @cf/ models in chat components.
